description: This file defines a Python class ChatClient used for interacting with a chat API provided by a LiteLLM proxy server. It includes methods for generating chat completions and streaming chat responses, handling request headers, and managing optional parameters for API calls.

classes.name: ChatClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the LiteLLM proxy chat API, providing methods for standard and streaming chat completions.

methods.name: Union[Dict[str,Any],requests.Request] completions( self, model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, str]], temperature: Optional[float] = None, top_p: Optional[float] = None, n: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens: Optional[int] = None, presence_penalty: Optional[float] = None, frequency_penalty: Optional[float] = None, user: Optional[str] = None, return_request: bool = False, )
methods.description: Sends a request to generate chat completions based on provided messages and parameters; can return either the response or the prepared request.

methods.name: Iterator[Dict[str,Any]] completions_stream( self, model: str, messages: List[Dict[str, str]], temperature: Optional[float] = None, top_p: Optional[float] = None, n: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens: Optional[int] = None, presence_penalty: Optional[float] = None, frequency_penalty: Optional[float] = None, user: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Streams chat completions in real-time, yielding chunks of response data as they arrive.
